applications.name: Pick Me Up - 3
applications.description: For every 10 hits on their Combo Meter, the Attacker gains a permanent 5% [k=glossary/energize]Energize[/k] Buff. When struck, the Attacker loses all Energize Buffs gained from Pick Me Up and takes 45% of the Defender's attack as Direct Damage for each Energize Buff removed this way. Landing the first hit of a Heavy Attack removes 1 Energize Buff.

applications.name: Turn the Tide
applications.description: One of the Attacker's Special Attacks is randomly chosen at the start of the fight. The chosen Special Attack rotates every 10 second(s), or when the Attacker ends a Combo with an Attack that didn't end their previous combo. The Attacker's Special Attacks suffer -100% Ability Accuracy and -90% Weakness, unless it is the chosen Special Attack.

applications.name: Counterstrike - 3
applications.description: Using the Dexterity Mastery to avoid an attack grants the Attacker a Fury Charge, increasing their Attack Rating by 15% per Charge.
